Title: Generally Available: Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management and Azure AI Gateway

Body.Content:
The integration between Microsoft Agent 365 and Azure API Management is now generally available, enabling organizations to centrally govern AI agents and MCP tools while enforcing security and access policies at runtime through Azure API Management and Azure AI Gateway. 

As organizations deploy more AI agents, managing access to MCP servers and tools, enforcing security policies, and monitoring agent activity becomes increasingly complex. This integration connects centralized governance in Microsoft Agent 365 with runtime enforcement in Azure API Management and Azure AI Gateway, helping organizations maintain visibility and control as agent adoption scales. 

With this integration, customers can: 

  • Discover and manage agent resources centrally: Automatically discover supported gateways and MCP servers registered in Azure API Management and Azure AI Gateway, creating a centralized inventory in Microsoft Agent 365. 

  • Enforce consistent access policies: Define governance policies in Microsoft Agent 365 and enforce access controls at runtime through Azure API Management and Azure AI Gateway, including server-level and individual tool-level blocking. 

  • Monitor and investigate agent activity: Gain visibility into agent-to-tool interactions and tool usage to support auditing, compliance, and security investigations. 

  • Protect agent interactions: Use Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Purview capabilities to help detect security threats and sensitive-information risks in supported tool requests and responses.
